messages:
lucy: Heads-up — PR incoming for a Private quickstart addendum. Need a short "networking troubleshooting" section for air-gapped installs: nftables example, local proxy/systemd snippet for KMS transport, and a couple quick connectivity checks. Can someone add concise examples? :wave:

sanjay: I can draft a tiny checklist + nft rules. Question: prefer showing TCP to a local proxy or a unix socket example for KMS transport?

lucy: TCP to a local proxy is preferable for customers who use simple port-forwarding. Keep examples tiny (under ~10 lines) and add a one-liner health check.

alex: Pasting a minimal systemd + example proxy args I used in the field:
```
# /etc/systemd/system/kms-proxy.service
[Unit]
Description=Redwood KMS local proxy
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/kms-proxy --listen 127.0.0.1:15000 --upstream 10.0.0.5:7890
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

alex: Minimal nftables snippet we can show (host-only):
``n
# allow KMS proxy on loopback only
table inet redwood {
  chain input {
    type filter hook input priority 0; policy accept;
    iif lo accept
    tcp dport 15000 counter accept
  }
}
```

alex: Quick checks I run after install: `nc -vz 127.0.0.1 15000` and `curl -v http://127.0.0.1:15000/healthz`

maria: I'll take wording + a short note about SELinux (setsebool httpd_can_network_connect on) and a tiny caution about IPv6 vs IPv4 loopback. Will open a PR with the snippets and a short troubleshooting checklist.

jen: small nit — prefer `127.0.0.1` in all examples instead of `localhost` to avoid IPv6 resolution inconsistencies.

lucy: Good call. Also add a one-line note linking to the key rotation doc. deploy-bot reported a broken link in private quickstart a moment ago.

deploy-bot: Link check report: /private/quickstart.md -> 404 (broken link found)

sanjay: Which path should the rotation link point to? I found `private/security/key-rotation.md` with an anchor `#rotation-practices`.

lucy: Yes — use `private/security/key-rotation.md#rotation-practices`. After the PR we should run the linkchecker again. :thumbsup:

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2312 — includes nftables example, systemd unit, curl/nc checks, SELinux note, and the corrected rotation link.

lucy: Awesome. If reviewers + UX give thumbs, I'll merge. Leaving a note to add a tiny screenshot or paste of `nc` output in a follow-up small commit. Closing loop here.
